title: RH Falsification Evidence Object
description: Structured evidence object for every report in the RH falsification experiment. result_hash and candidate_key identify a finished calculation (see ROOT-IDENTITY.md). Empty parents plus no fingerprint is unattributed, not a root. src/ledger_adapter.py maps this object onto the canonical node of provenance/evidence-lineage.schema.json: claim_id to node_id, agent_id to observer_id, method to source_id, parent_evidence_ids to copied_from, and the fingerprint to copied_from, pointing at the registry root issued for that calculation. There is no confidence, score or weight field, and additionalProperties is false, so an object carrying one is invalid.

agent_id.description: The identity that signs issuance requests. In a deployment this must be the authenticated identity of the poster. Never a root by itself.

result_hash.description: Identity of the finished calculation (preferred fingerprint field, the name used across the repository). Two reports with the same result_hash are one root even if parents are omitted.

candidate_key.description: Identity field used with method when result_hash is absent (fingerprint cand:method:candidate_key). Not a root by itself.

parent_evidence_ids.description: Declared parents, mapped to copied_from. Untrusted. An empty array means no declared parent, which does not make the report a root. Empty parents plus no result_hash or candidate_key fingerprint is unattributed and is quarantined by default (zero roots). A report with a declared parent is a recorded copy and adds no root.

source_dependencies.description: Sources this report depends on (papers, tables, external datasets). Recorded only; not yet mapped to read_from.

independent_of.description: Claim IDs the reporter asserts independence from. Declared lineage to be checked, never trusted (EXPERIMENT-001 corrupted-lineage finding). Not read by the ledger.

observed_at.description: Observation time in seconds since the epoch. The issuance cap (2 roots per hour per signed identity) is counted in the hour this falls in.
